tone.quote: These data reveal that the main difference between verbs with the prefix [m-] and those with [mē-] is based on the special stress position each group takes. The primary stress in the verbs with [m-] is on the first syllable of the stem and not on the prefix. In verbs with [mē-], the primary stress is on the prefix itself.
tone.locator: p. 9 (Orientalia Suecana LIX), section on the non-past prefix m-/mē
tone.summary: No tone described; stress in prefixed verb forms is morphologically placed (stem-initial with m-, on the prefix with mē-); nothing said about nouns or about pitch.
